hypothesis: Filtering marginal SMA200 entries may reduce whipsaw losses without losing too much trend profit.
baseline: Prior completed daily close > SMA200 including that close. Long spot BTC or cash. Evaluate at UTC midnight, execute at 01:00 hourly open proxy.
filter: At the start of each baseline exposure episode ONLY, accept iff previous close - SMA200 > 0.5 * ATR14. ATR14 is the arithmetic mean of the latest 14 true ranges, using prior close for each. If rejected, stay flat for the ENTIRE baseline episode; no delayed entry. Exit unchanged when close <= SMA200.
split_policy: Each split starts in cash; if already above SMA200 at start, treat as boundary entry and flag it. Terminal exits are administrative. Never carry selected state across splits.
annual_walk_forward_diagnostics: 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 partial year; no fitting or tuning in any fold. Reset to cash per fold. These are dependent descriptive views, not extra independent tests.
random_control: Uniform random subsets of baseline episodes, retaining EXACTLY as many episodes as filtered strategy in each split. 2000 seeded draws with replacement across subsets; archive selected episode IDs. Same entry/exit and costs. Holding duration/exposure NOT matched; diagnostic, not causal proof.
uncertainty: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap, 30-day blocks, 5000 draws, filtered-minus-baseline daily Sharpe. Serial dependence and small sample remain limitations.
decision: RESEARCH_ONLY always. Suggest prospective paper consideration only if historical test base and double cost CAGR > 0; all main splits filtered Sharpe > baseline; historical test drawdown no worse than baseline; primary CI lower > 0; matched-count random p <= 0.05; historical test >=20 natural completed accepted episodes. Any sample shortfall -> INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; otherwise failure -> STOP_THIS_HYPOTHESIS. No auto activation.
limitations: All historical data already examined in SMA200 v1; no untouched holdout claim.
Fixed 0.5 ATR is a research choice, not an optimized or proven threshold.
Hourly open references are not executable fill guarantees. Costs, min notional and intraday risk limitations inherited from v1.
No Jev, liquidation data, production DB, alerts, collector or scheduler changes.
baseline_provenance: Copied functions from isolated btc-trend-research-20261007/research.py through shift_control; original main omitted.
